interview.hardest_part: Precise beak grabs and timed NPC interactions in multi-step carry-and-stealth puzzles, under a 3-hour wall-clock cap that leaves only a short stretch of actual game time.
interview.likely_failure: Burning the time budget in the garden on mis-grabs, bad drops, and repeated walks, before the high street, pub, or model-village bell sequence.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The game pauses while I plan; click-to-move pathfinding; a visible task list; a fixed, familiar village; and known puzzle solutions.
interview.harmful_mechanics: One-second indivisible actions with no mid-step correction, fussy grab range and aim, NPCs reacting during those seconds, and thinking latency counting against the time limit.
